description: Original cream, sage, navy and walnut arched office jukebox. Source PNG preserved unmodified. Selected the original result after comparing a background-edit attempt.
normalization: Runtime trims alpha >32 then samples once with nearest-neighbor interpolation. Logical bounds are used for placement and interaction.
audio: Three original deterministic melodies in web/js/jukebox.js are synthesized locally with Web Audio. There are no third-party music files or network audio requests.
